motion.help:
Press Enter or leave a field to apply a number. Sliders apply immediately.
Capture timing limits response (4096 samples / 48 kHz: about 85 ms).
Shorter time settings do not shorten the capture interval.
settings.layout_help:
Layout and LED settings are independent of themes.
Themes change colors only.
Aspect ratio controls shape (1: square, 2: wide).
Drag a main-window corner to resize the whole display.
colors.help:
Themes store colors only. Editing a built-in color creates a user copy.
Confirm a color to preview it, then save your changes.
settings.actions_help:
Apply: confirm changes (saved on normal exit).
Cancel: restore the last applied state, or the state before opening.
